sources.entry: JARR - JARR (Just Another RSS Reader) is a web-based news aggregator and reader (fork of Newspipe). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: JARR (Just Another RSS Reader) is a web-based news aggregator and feed reader, described in the awesome-selfhosted listing as a fork of Newspipe.
summary.what_it_does: The README contains only a "Give Up GitHub" notice saying the project has moved to an unnamed location and objecting to GitHub Copilot's use of its code. It does not describe features, installation, or usage. The awesome-selfhosted listing metadata says JARR is a web-based news aggregator and reader that is a fork of Newspipe, with a demo and source code available and a Docker/Python stack. Beyond that, no capabilities are documented in the README.
use_cases: following news sites and blogs in one place
notable: Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Feed Readers
caveats: README is nearly empty: only a notice that the project has moved elsewhere, so no setup or feature details are available here
Project states it has given up GitHub; the current canonical location is not named in the README
